name: Fat/Skinny Weight Slider - (Krea-2 + ZIT)
description: Krea 2 The current Krea2 version is half the strength of the first version that was available. This was done to make the range from -10 to 10, so it is as simple as possible to know where in the range you should keep it within. And to match my Z-variant. Recommended range: -10.0 to 10.0 ZIT V2: Sort of fixed the problem with large women getting more makeup and skinny women lost makeup. But still a small problem at the extreme ends of the range. A bit more stable overall, but not a huge upgrade. This is a model i made in parallel with a Klein 9B version to compare against eachother, so that will probably be released soon as well. Recommended range: -10.0 to 10.0 All my work is 100% free. The only thing that really matters to me is people leaving a review , good or bad . I will NEVER remove or block anyone for leaving a bad review, so don't be afraid to give me criticism. I'm stating this because when a creator blocks someone for leaving a bad review, that person can no longer see any of the creator's models, essentially muting their critics. This is something I'm highly critical of, and I believe it's a fundamental quality problem on this site.
